text:
morgan: Heads-up — saw a noisy spike in embeddings quality metrics after the latest sweep. I have a one-line preprocessor fix. Requesting a quiet-window exemption to push a hotfix during the active change window (03:00-05:00 UTC). Ping @sre-oncall and release manager.

deploy-bot: New deploy request created by morgan: `embeddings-hotfix-432` (change-window-exempt). Requires release manager approval and canary policy. Request ID: 3532101111.

ada: On call — what's the scope? Any DB/schema migrations or model changes?

morgan: No DB work, just 2 files in the embeddings preprocessor. PR: https://gh/redwood/infra/pull/432 — small logic tweak to normalize whitespace. No model reweights.

jon: FYI we should pin the model-serving image for this hotfix to avoid runtime lib drift. I'll prepare a canary image tag `rc-1.14-emb-hotfix`.

kai: Suggest canary rollout: start at 2% traffic, evaluate after 10m. If CPU < 60% and p99 < 500ms and errors < 0.5% promote to 25%.

ada: I can approve an exemption with constraints: (1) no migrations; (2) hotfix must be revertable in <15m; (3) monitoring hooks in place and SRE watching. @deploy-bot, please start canary with those constraints when approved.

deploy-bot: Canary initiated for request 3532101111 — target service `embeddings-service`. Canary group: `quiet-win-canary-3532`. Start: 2% traffic. Health checks: liveness, p99 latency, error rate. Auto-fallback enabled: will revert to `redwood/embeddings:stable-2.3.1` on failure.

sre-oncall: Watching the canary. I'll temporarily silence low-priority alerts and focus on tail latency and error spikes. If error rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m we rollback immediately.

morgan: Rollback playbook (short):
```
# rollback to stable image
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embeddings-service 
  embeddings=redwood/embeddings:stable-2.3.1
# notify deploy-bot to mark request as rolled-back
deploy-bot pin rollback 3532101111
```

ada: Also add a one-line release note entry so customers/internal teams know it was a tiny fix: https://docs/internal/releases/embeddings-hotfix (done). If this takes >1hr we'll open an incident and do a post-mortem.

deploy-bot: Canary health update @t+8m — CPU 42%, p99 220ms, error rate 0.03% — metrics within thresholds. Promoting to 25% per policy.

kai: Promoted to 25%. Observe for 15m; if stable, schedule full 100% at +30m from now.

ada: Sounds good. I'll mark the exemption approved and own the rollback window. :thumbsup:

morgan: Thanks everyone — will monitor logs and metrics. Closing thread if full rollout completes without regression.
